verdict.rationale: Grafana's provisioning and observability-as-code docs show dashboards/data sources/alerts can be defined in files, version-controlled via GitOps, and deployed through CI/CD pipelines with automated testing — supporting version and review workflows for automation configs. However, there is no explicit documentation of a rollback mechanism specifically for automations (e.g., alert rules, provisioning) beyond generic git-revert implication, and no hands-on evidence of the review/rollback flow in practice. missing for 10: explicit rollback tooling/UI for alerts or automations, worked example of reviewing/rolling back a specific automation, independent corroboration of this workflow.
